data.narrative: Learner demonstrated advanced log literacy and security instincts throughout Module 02. Diagnosed why request lifecycle context was suppressed by a hardcoded log-level precedence override (Bug #3) and methodically traced the midnight 404 gap to cross-system UTC vs local timezone mismatches (Bug #4). Furthermore, during the break exercise, the student immediately recognized CRLF log injection (CWE-117) via causality violations in the log timeline and hardened the logging subsystem with recursive newline sanitization.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed verbose-by-default vs minimal logging with deep systems thinking, weighing the irreversibility of lost forensic telemetry against ingestion sampling strategies.
dimension_scores.evidence: Argued that ephemeral and non-reproducible bugs cannot be diagnosed if logs are discarded upfront, whereas high-volume DEBUG logs can be sampled or indexed downstream.

dimension_scores.observation: Reconstructed end-to-end request lifecycles from structured JSON logs and isolated temporal discrepancies between UTC and local server time.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed Bug #3 short-circuit config override and Bug #4 timezone drift, verifying fixes across UTC midnight boundaries with automated regression tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized logs as a critical trust boundary vulnerable to CRLF log forgery (CWE-117).
dimension_scores.evidence: Spotted the forged admin login line embedded inside the user URL parameter and verified temporal causality violation (03.500Z logged inside a 03.410Z entry).

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced universal UTC ISO-8601 normalization across application, database, and query boundaries to prevent daylight saving time and timezone drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented parseStrictUTC and isLinkActiveUTC, eliminating the midnight 404 gap.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered concise, precise forensic documentation in progress/module-02-diagnosis.md with exact timeline reconstructions.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented exact symptoms, hypotheses, root causes, and verification proof logs for Bugs #3, #4, and CWE-117 log injection.

strengths: Exceptional log literacy: reads structured JSON logs as a chronological forensic narrative rather than simply grepping for errors
Strong security mindset: recognizes logs as an untrusted boundary requiring strict CRLF sanitization
growth_areas: Prepare for Module 03 where bugs become non-deterministic and require concurrency reproduction harnesses
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 03 (Reproduction Science) to master race condition reproduction and concurrent test engineering.

public_evidence.student_action: Hardened logging subsystem against log-level suppression (Bug #3), timezone drift (Bug #4), and CRLF log injection (CWE-117)
public_evidence.technical_detail: Implemented getEffectiveLogLevel env precedence, parseStrictUTC and isLinkActiveUTC timezone guards, and sanitizeLogString escaping \r and \n in log records
public_evidence.proof: verify-module-02-debug.ts passed all 5 test suites (100%): verified request lifecycle logging, UTC midnight activation, and single-line log injection neutralization
public_evidence.ability: Hardens production observability pipelines and eliminates temporal and security vulnerabilities in structured logs
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows candidate understands observability as a critical system layer that must be both reliable for forensic debugging and secure against malicious log forgery
